packageRules.description: provider/ builds against crossplane-runtime v1, which targets controller-runtime v0.19. v0.23 added Apply to client.SubResourceWriter, which crossplane-runtime's wrapperStatusClient does not implement, so anything >=0.23 fails to compile. Lift this once the provider is migrated to the Crossplane v2 APIs.
controller-runtime v0.22.x cannot compile against client-go >=0.36: v0.36 added HasSyncedChecker to cache.ResourceEventHandlerRegistration. Tied to the controller-runtime cap above.
crossplane-runtime v2 is not a version bump: it moved the common API types to crossplane/apis/v2, so adopting it is a Crossplane v2 API migration. Keep major updates off the automated path.
